output.evaluation_note: The Part of Speech (POS) is incorrectly listed as 'verb' for all three languages. 'Organic' (English), '有機' (Japanese), and 'hữu cơ' (Vietnamese) are adjectives or nouns/noun adjuncts, not verbs. This fundamental grammatical error makes the entry pedagogically unsound and misleading, as it misrepresents the core function and usage of the word in each language.
